about.title: Ibyerekeye JobConnect Rwanda
about.intro: JobConnect Rwanda ni urubuga rw'ikoranabuhanga ruhuza abashaka akazi n'abantu ku giti cyabo, ubucuruzi buto, ibigo, imiryango n'abategura ibirori batanga amahirwe y'akazi mu gace batuyemo.
about.problemText: Amakuru ku kazi ko mu gace, ak'igice cy'igihe n'ak'igihe gito akwirakwira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, mu matsinda ya WhatsApp, mu nshuti no ku mbuga nyinshi. Abashaka akazi babura amahirwe, abakoresha nabo bakagorwa no kubona vuba abantu bafite ubumenyi bukenewe.
about.solutionText: Urubuga rumwe ruri ku murongo kandi rwizewe aho abatanga akazi batangaza amahirwe, abashaka akazi bagashakisha, bagasaba kandi bagakurikirana ubusabe bwabo - hamwe n'igenzura rikumira uburiganya n'amatangazo ayobya.
about.obj1: Guhuriza hamwe amahirwe y'akazi yo mu Rwanda ku rubuga rumwe byoroshye gushakishirizaho.
about.obj2: Gufasha abanyeshuri, abarangije amashuri, abanyabukorikori n'abikorera kubona akazi gahuye n'ubumenyi bwabo n'aho batuye.
about.obj3: Guha abatanga akazi igikoresho cyoroshye cyo gutangaza akazi, gusuzuma abasabye no guha akazi vuba.
about.obj4: Gutuma gusaba akazi bikorwa mu mucyo hakurikiranwa uko ubusabe buhagaze n'imenyesha.
about.obj5: Kurinda abakoresha binyuze mu gutanga raporo, igenzura no kwemeza abatanga akazi.

privacy.title: Politiki y'ibanga
privacy.intro: Iyi politiki isobanura amakuru bwite JobConnect Rwanda ikusanya, uko tuyakoresha n'amahitamo ufite. Dukoresha amakuru bwite hubahirijwe Itegeko N° 058/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite n'ubuzima bwite.

sections.heading: Amakuru dukusanya
sections.body: Amakuru ya konti (amazina, imeyili, telefoni, aho uherereye n'uruhare), amakuru y'umwirondoro wihitiyemo kongeramo (ubumenyi, amashuri, uburambe, incamake, ifoto na CV), amatangazo y'akazi n'amakuru y'ibigo atangwa n'abatanga akazi, ubusabe n'amabaruwa asaba akazi, raporo wohereza, n'amakuru ya tekiniki akenewe mu kurinda umutekano (nk'igihe winjiriye).

sections.heading: Uko dukoresha amakuru yawe
sections.body: Gufungura no kurinda konti yawe, kwerekana akazi, kohereza ubusabe ku batanga akazi wihitiyemo, kukumenyesha ibijyanye n'ubusabe bwawe, kugenzura ibikubiyemo no gukumira uburiganya, no kunoza urubuga. Ntabwo tugurisha amakuru yawe bwite.

sections.heading: Ushobora kubona amakuru yawe
sections.body: Umwirondoro wawe rusange werekana amazina, aho uherereye, ubumenyi, incamake, amashuri n'uburambe. Imeyili, telefoni na CV byawe bigaragara kuri wowe, ku bayobozi b'urubuga no ku batanga akazi wasabyeho akazi gusa. Imyirondoro y'ibigo n'amatangazo y'akazi ni rusange.

sections.heading: Umutekano
sections.body: Amagambo y'ibanga abikwa mu buryo bwizewe (hashing), kwinjira bikoresha cookies zizewe, kandi gukurura CV byemererwa abafite uburenganzira gusa. Nta serivisi yo kuri interineti idafite ibyago na gato, bityo koresha ijambo ry'ibanga rikomeye kandi ryihariye.

sections.heading: Uburenganzira bwawe
sections.body: Ushobora kureba no kuvugurura umwirondoro wawe igihe cyose, gusiba CV yawe, no gusiba burundu konti yawe mu igenamiterere ryayo. Gusiba konti bikuraho umwirondoro wawe, ubusabe, akazi wabitse n'imenyesha.

sections.heading: Twandikire
sections.body: Ku bibazo cyangwa ibyifuzo bijyanye n'ibanga, twandikire kuri {{email}}.

terms.title: Amategeko n'amabwiriza
terms.intro: Iyo ufunguye konti cyangwa ukoresha JobConnect Rwanda uba wemeye aya mategeko. Yasome witonze.

sections.heading: Gukoresha urubuga
sections.body: Ugomba gutanga amakuru y'ukuri kandi ukabika ibanga ry'amakuru yo kwinjira. Uryozwa ibikorwa byose bikorewe kuri konti yawe. Konti z'abayobozi zifungurwa n'abashinzwe urubuga gusa.

sections.heading: Amabwiriza ku batanga akazi
sections.body: Amatangazo y'akazi agomba gusobanura amahirwe nyayo mu kuri, harimo igihembo n'ibisabwa. Abatanga akazi ntibemerewe kwaka abasaba amafaranga ayo ari yo yose yo gusaba cyangwa guhabwa akazi, gutangaza ibivangura, ibinyuranyije n'amategeko cyangwa ibiyobya, kandi amakuru y'abasaba agomba gukoreshwa mu gutoranya abakozi gusa.

sections.heading: Amabwiriza ku bashaka akazi
sections.body: Ubusabe bugomba kuba ukuri. Ntukohereze dosiye zirimo virusi cyangwa ibikubiyemo by'undi muntu. Menyesha akazi gateye inkeke ukoresheje buto yo gutanga raporo.

sections.heading: Igenzura
sections.body: Abayobozi b'urubuga bashobora gusuzuma raporo, gukuraho akazi, no guhagarika cyangwa gusiba konti zinyuranya n'aya mategeko cyangwa zishyira abandi mu kaga.

sections.heading: Nta cyizere cy'akazi gihamye
sections.body: JobConnect Rwanda ihuza abatanga akazi n'abagashaka ariko ntabwo iba umwe mu bagize amasezerano y'akazi, kandi ntiyizeza ko akazi cyangwa umukandida bizaboneka. Buri gihe banza ugenzure utanga akazi mbere yo gutanga amakuru y'ingenzi cyangwa gutangira akazi.

sections.heading: Impinduka no kutwandikira
sections.body: Dushobora kuvugurura aya mategeko; gukomeza gukoresha urubuga bisobanura ko wemeye amategeko avuguruwe. Ibibazo wabyohereza kuri {{email}}.
